errors.connection_needs_user: Only a signed-in member can connect or disconnect an account.
errors.provider_not_configured: This provider is not set up on this instance. Ask your administrator to configure it.
errors.capabilities_required: Choose at least one thing to connect.
errors.authorization_code_invalid: The sign-in with the provider expired or was already used. Start connecting again.
errors.provider_unavailable: The provider could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.consent_incomplete: Campbooks was not given access to what you chose. Connect again and allow access.
errors.no_offline_access: The provider did not allow Campbooks to stay connected. Connect again and allow access.
errors.account_mismatch: You signed in with a different account than the one you are extending. Use the same account.
errors.account_connected_by_another_member: Another member of this workspace already connected this account.
errors.needs_reauth: This connection needs you to connect the account again before it can sync.
errors.unknown_data_centre: Campbooks does not know the Zoho data centre of this account. Ask your administrator.
errors.no_mailbox: This account has no mailbox Campbooks can read.
errors.disconnect_owner_only: Only the member who connected this account can disconnect it.
errors.step_up_required: For your security, sign in again before connecting a mailbox with its password.
errors.imap_connects_with_a_password: A mailbox over IMAP is connected with its password, not through a sign-in page.
errors.imap_username_invalid: Enter a valid username for this mailbox.
errors.imap_password_invalid: Enter the mailbox's password (at most 1024 characters, on one line).
errors.imap_servers_required: Campbooks could not find this mailbox's servers. Enter its IMAP and SMTP servers.
errors.use_native_provider: This mailbox is at {{provider}}: connect it with {{provider}} instead of a password.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed sign-ins to this mailbox. Wait an hour and try again.
errors.imap_login_refused_one: The mail server refused the sign-in. This provider needs an app password: create one in your account's security settings and use it here instead of your usual password.
errors.imap_login_refused_other: The mail server refused the sign-in. Check the username and password. If your provider offers app passwords, use one.
errors.smtp_login_refused_one: The outgoing mail server refused the sign-in. This provider needs an app password: create one in your account's security settings and use it here.
errors.smtp_login_refused_other: The outgoing mail server (SMTP) refused the sign-in. Check the username and password, and that the server lets you send.
errors.imap_busy: The mail server is busy and did not let Campbooks in. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.imap_unreachable: The mail server (IMAP) could not be reached. Check its name and port, and try again.
errors.smtp_unreachable: The outgoing mail server (SMTP) could not be reached. Check its name and port, and try again.
errors.imap_tls_failed: The mail server's certificate is not valid for its name, so Campbooks did not connect. Check the server name.
errors.smtp_tls_failed: The outgoing mail server's certificate is not valid for its name, so Campbooks did not connect. Check the server name.
errors.imap_not_an_imap_server: The server at this address and port is not an IMAP mail server. Check the server and port.
errors.host_refused: Campbooks cannot connect to this server: it is on a private network, or the port is not a mail port (993, 143, 465 or 587).
errors.starttls_missing: The server does not offer an encrypted connection, so Campbooks did not send your password. Use the server's encrypted port (993 for IMAP, 465 for SMTP).
